method: Root operated the actual authenticated local browser through CUA; independent read-only SQLite snapshots captured surrounding state. Screenshots were visually inspected in the task transcript, not saved as files.

cases.input: Load built-in fixed sample under saved personal-code-delivery v2
cases.observed: bounded-worker / T2 / fixture-profile v1; one eligible candidate

cases.input: Repeat unchanged simulation and expand input binding
cases.observed: Same rule, candidate and all three displayed snapshot hashes

cases.input: Set task complexity to T1; current fast_qualified group is empty
cases.observed: Old report removed immediately; new simulation blocked with NO_STAGE_CANDIDATE

cases.input: Restore readiness ready; set critical risk while complexity is T1
Edit critical-worker draft priority from 100 to 102
cases.observed: Old report removed; next simulation displays priority 102 and a changed rule/policy hash

cases.input: Reload final rebuilt UI, reopen same saved project and load sample
cases.observed: Saved critical-worker priority is still 100; original bounded-worker T2 and snapshot hashes return

cases.input: Expand input binding in 554px viewport before and after CSS repair
cases.observed: Before: rule hash overflowed card and page scrolled horizontally. After: full hash wraps inside card and horizontal page scrollbar disappears.

state_comparison.scope: Project record, full published rulebook, profile enabled flags, publication history, and all logical Run/capacity table counts and row hashes captured by the helper. Session/bootstrap stores were not read.

scope_limit: Normal/T1/T0/critical/edit cases were observed before the numeric-import and CSS-only fixes; final browser reran sample and digest rendering. File import, multi-candidate rank, authentication races, duplicate keys and numerical edge cases are covered by component/HTTP checks, not claimed as real browser actions. Model endpoint zero-receive evidence is in HTTP tests, not inferred from the page counter.
